Ahead of this unit's own onset stands oshb:Isa.38.22, marked by a parashah SAMEKH mark (single-witness). Hezekiah's own display of his treasury follows at web:Isa.39.2, itself a ketiv/qere verse (single-witness apparatus, oshb:Isa.39.2), and the unit closes with Isaiah's questioning and Hezekiah's own account of what the envoys saw at web:Isa.39.4, “Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”” (web:Isa.39.4), in Hebrew וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּבֵיתֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵיתִי֙ רָא֔וּ לֹֽא הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הִרְאִיתִ֖ים בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי (oshb:Isa.39.4, tier: byte). Isaiah's own judgment word opens the following unit, introduced by a fresh herald-summons at oshb:Isa.39.5, שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת (oshb:Isa.39.5, tier: byte), 'hear the word of Yahweh of hosts' — a four-token frame unique in the book (sweep: 1 verse book-wide) — rather than continuing this embassy report.
